Thanks — adding a few technical flags so CS has context before kickoff.

Technical summary / recommendations:
- We'll deploy the "med-moderate" variant for pilot (balanced latency/quality). Production threshold set to med-high after pilot if quality gates pass.
- Recommended quantization: 4-bit QAT profile we've validated on Dedicated (saves ~40% token costs, latency impact minimal for 512-token sequences).
- Token limits: set soft limit 1024, hard cutoff 2048 for request size; we should confirm expected max question length with them.
- Data retention: their compliance team requested audit logs and per-request retention windows; we can expose per-customer retention config but will need legal approval for <90-day retention windows (SOC2 scope).

Pre-kickoff deliverables for Riverside (please collect ahead of the meeting):
1) Example request/response payloads + field-level mapping (JSON files).
2) Network allowlist and SAML metadata (or API key plan if they prefer not to use SSO initially).
3) List of test users & sample PHI use cases (for runbook and privacy review).

I'll prep an integration checklist and a short runbook (attach during kickoff).

-Karthik
